senses.definition: n.m. 1 K 10:11 & f. v 22 coll. ships, fleet—abs. 1 K 9:26 +; cstr. 10:11 +;—of Sol. 1 K 9:26, 27; called א׳ תַרְשִׁישׁ (i.e. large, sea-going vessels, such as sail to Tarshish) 10:22(×2); א׳ חִירָם 10:11, 22; propelled by oars א׳־שַׁיִט Is 33:21.
